I1.quote: The hydrogen storage capacity of the GO/rGO sample is measured using indigenously fabricated high pressure hydrogen storage Sieverts’ type volumetric setup at room temperature and pressure up to 80 bars.

I2.quote: In present experimental investigations, GO was found to exhibit better H2 uptake capacity (1.90wt. %) as compared to rGO (1.34 wt. %) at room temperature.

I3.quote: Searched text, captions and Fig. 8 axes for a numeric or recoverable H2-uptake temperature. Found only 'room temperature' with 80 bar (Abstract; Hydrogen Storage Performance; Conclusion); Fig. 8 plots wt% against time with no temperature.

I4.quote: Searched text, figures and captions for a specific surface area (BET, Langmuir, any method) of GO or rGO. None reported; the only area value, '2630 cm2/gm' (Introduction), describes graphene generally, not a measured sample.

I5.quote: Hydrogen storage properties of the derivatives of graphene, graphene oxide/reduced- graphene oxide are studied in this paper.

notes: Page numbers are PDF pages (pages/main-NN.png); printed page = PDF page - 1, because PDF p. 1 is the Ulster University repository cover sheet for this Author Accepted Manuscript. I1/I2: H2 uptake of GO and rGO measured with a home-built Sieverts volumetric apparatus (Section 2.3, PDF p. 6-7; Hydrogen Storage Performance, PDF p. 14; Fig. 8 is uptake in wt% against time, PDF p. 14). I3 decision: pressure (80 bar) is stated, but the only temperature given for any uptake value is 'room temperature' (Abstract; 'recorded upto a pressure of 80bar at room temperature', PDF p. 14; Conclusion, PDF p. 15). The registered data dictionary (temperature_unstated) treats a condition stated only in words ('room temperature') as not stated numerically and not imputed, and protocol section 3 imputes a number only for 'liquid nitrogen'; so no uptake value has a stated or recoverable temperature. If a resolver reads 'room temperature' as a stated temperature, I3 is met and the first applicable code becomes no_surface_area, because I4 also fails: no surface area by any method is reported for GO or rGO (characterization is SEM, TEM, XRD, Raman, FTIR only). The paper is excluded under either reading. not_primary, retracted, duplicate_data: none applies (original research article, record is_retracted false, no retraction notice, no statement that the uptake data were published before).
